{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}')

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[~qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the remaining rows
total_remaining = len(df_filtered)
print(f'Total orders after filtering: {total_remaining}')

# Check channel distribution
channel_dist = df_filtered['channel'].value_counts()
print(f'Channel distribution after filtering:\n{channel_dist}')

# Check for imbalance in customer_segment across channels
segment_channel_cross = pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['customer_segment'])
print(f'Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:\n{segment_channel_cross}')"}
